input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The merging isn't happening in the CSV writer—it's the ingest dedupe step. `dedupeKey` in `src/ingest/dedupe.ts` builds its key from only `date`, `amount`, and `description`, so two transactions that differ only by currency (e.g. same date/amount/description, one EUR and one USD) hash to the same key and one is dropped as a duplicate. Since transactions only started carrying a currency field after 3.2.0, this collision wasn't possible before. The fix should include currency in `dedupeKey` (e.g. `[t.date, t.amount, t.description, t.currency].join("|")`).

input.title: Include currency in dedupe key to avoid merging distinct transactions
input.body: File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts. The dedupeKey function builds its key from date, amount, and description only, so since 3.2.0 transactions that differ only by currency (e.g. the same date/amount/description in EUR vs USD) collide and one is dropped as a duplicate. Update dedupeKey to also include t.currency in the joined key so transactions with different currencies are no longer treated as the same transaction.
